profile.ja: 吸血鬼と人間のハーフでありながら対魔忍として生きる異端の存在。祖父である“ふうま八将”心願寺幻庵から剣術の指南を受け、ゆくゆくは八将を継ぐと目されていた実力者。しかし、かつてのふうま宗家の反乱に連座して幻庵は失脚。跡目を継ぐはずだった紅もふうまの里を離れ、現在は闇の都市として名高いセンザキを拠点に独自に活動している。彼女が信じる“義”のために。
profile.en: She is a half-vampire, half-human outcast who lives as a Taimanin. She received swordsmanship instruction from her grandfather, the Fuuma Eight-General Shinganji Gen-an, and was once slated to inherit his position. However, because her grandfather was disgraced for aiding the Fuuma main family during an internal conflict, Kurenai left the Fuuma village and now operates independently with no allegiance. From her former Fuuma Eight-General lineage she is also an old acquaintance of Fuuma Kotaro, the heir of the main family. She can deliberately unleash the dormant "demon" power within herself to gain overwhelming strength. When she does, her eyes turn crimson, black wings sprout on her back, and she becomes surrounded by a miasma of darkness. In this demonic awakening, Kurenai possesses a terrifying power far beyond that of ordinary humans, but the price is that her body and mind are gradually consumed by the demon, causing her to lose her humanity and will over time.

text.ja: あたしは暴力教会のクソ尼、エダってもんだ。儲け話なら大歓迎――あっ、お、お前か。いや、これは例の映画の台本読みでな……
text.en: I'm Edá, a damn nun from the Church of Violence. I'm all for a profit scheme—oh, it's you. No, this is just a read-through of that movie script…

text.ja: ここの台本読みに付き合ってくれないか？　『この田舎もん！　原版はこっちのもんだ……く、クソッ……タレ……』や、やっぱり別の所にしよう
text.en: Want to join me in reading this script? "You country bumpkin! The original is ours… damn… slime…" Maybe we should pick something else.

text.ja: この格好、思った以上に動きづらいな……この姿で大立ち回りをする彼女には脱帽だよ。しかも酔っていてもあの動きだろう？
text.en: This outfit is more restrictive than I thought… seeing her go all-out like this, I'm impressed. And even drunk she moves like that?

text.ja: 彼女の話は結構教養になる事も多いんだぞ……例えば聖典の一節に曰く『厄介事を持ち込むなこのアマ』だそうだ
text.en: She actually teaches me a lot… For example, a holy text says, "Don't bring trouble, you bitch."

text.ja: エダの事はとても尊敬できる女性だと感じたが、いざ演じるとなると台詞回しが……ええと、結構独特でな。もっと練習しなくては
text.en: I respect Edá as a woman, but when it comes to performing, her line delivery is… well, pretty unique. I need more practice.

text.ja: あやめ？　彼女は留守だぞ。休暇を取ってベガスに……いや！　これはエダの真似じゃなくて本当に……ああ、もうややこしいな！
text.en: Ayame? She's not here. She took a vacation to Vegas… no! This isn't Edá's imitation, it's real… Ah, this is getting messy!

text.ja: 付き合えよふうま、ダチだろ！　……う、うぅ、彼女のようにすれば気負わず誘えるかと思ったが、余計に恥ずかしいだけだったな
text.en: Come on, Fuuma, you're a buddy! …Ugh, I thought if I acted like her I could invite you without feeling self-conscious, but it just made it more embarrassing.

text.ja: 彼女の祖国への気持ち、正直私も重なる所は多い。私も彼女のように、どんな状況に翻弄されようと自分の信念だけは最後まで曲げずにいたいな
text.en: I honestly share a lot of her feelings toward her homeland. Like her, I want to stay true to my convictions no matter how I'm tossed around.
